scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev --workspace @face/api" "npm run dev --workspace @face/web"
scripts.dev:local: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web,model "npm run dev --workspace @face/api" "npm run dev --workspace @face/web" "powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/start-local-resume.ps1"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @face/api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @face/api && npm run build --workspace @face/web
scripts.lint: eslint apps/web/src apps/api/src packages/shared/contracts tests apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check:public && npm run lint && npm run check:components && npm run test
